title: A Lesson from the Silence
description: During the Silence, Gnarl turned magical overexposure into a practical question: if enough magic is forced into flesh, can flesh itself become machinery? Begin with Biomancy's own primordial-core and living-flesh milestones. This is Gnarl's recent discipline of Evil-Mana biological engineering, not an ancient imported cosmology.
description_completed: The Overlord has begun working through the Biomancy principles Gnarl developed during the Silence.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign
